title: Marketing automation: the fitnessmarketing trend for 2019 (3/3)

facts.fact: The blog post was published on 18 December 2018.
Hidden Profits Marketing states that its LeadConnect automation requires only about a 30-second effort from the gym, per the vendor's own description.
facts.quote: A 30 second effort for you, with incredible (proven) results for your fitness sales.

facts.fact: Hidden Profits Marketing says its digital fitness marketing services are available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand and around the world.
facts.quote: Available in the United States of America,Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand and around the world.
